name: deep recursion: asyncEach over 120 items
template: {% asyncEach x in range(120) %}{{ x }},{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: asyncEach over 120 pairs
template: {% set arr = [] %}{% for i in range(120) %}{% set _ = arr.push([i, "b"]) %}{% endfor %}{% asyncEach a, b in arr %}{{ a }}{{ b }},{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: asyncEach over 120 triples
template: {% set arr = [] %}{% for i in range(120) %}{% set _ = arr.push([i, "b", "c"]) %}{% endfor %}{% asyncEach a, b, c in arr %}{{ a }}{{ b }}{{ c }},{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: asyncEach over 120 quadruples
template: {% set arr = [] %}{% for i in range(120) %}{% set _ = arr.push([i, "b", "c", "d"]) %}{% endfor %}{% asyncEach a, b, c, d in arr %}{{ a }}{{ b }}{{ c }}{{ d }},{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: asyncEach over an object of 120 keys
template: {% asyncEach k, v in obj %}{{ k }}={{ v }},{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: asyncEach over 120 items, each including a template

templates.page.njk: {% asyncEach x in range(120) %}{% include "item.njk" %}{% endeach %}

name: deep recursion: a template that extends a layout and includes itself 120 deep

templates.self.njk: {% extends "layout.njk" %}{% block b %}{% if n > 0 %}{% set n = n - 1 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}.{% endblock %}

name: deep recursion: a template that calls super() and includes itself 120 deep

templates.self.njk: {% extends "layout.njk" %}{% block b %}{{ super() }}{% if n > 0 %}{% set n = n - 1 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}.{% endblock %}

name: deep recursion: a template that includes itself 120 deep from an asyncEach

templates.self.njk: {% set n = n - 1 %}{% asyncEach x in [1] %}{% if n > 0 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}{% endeach %}.

name: deep recursion: a template that includes itself 120 deep from an asyncEach over an object

templates.self.njk: {% set n = n - 1 %}{% asyncEach k, v in {a: 1} %}{% if n > 0 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}{% endeach %}.

name: deep recursion: a template that includes itself 110 deep and reads a context variable

templates.self.njk: {% if n > 0 %}{% set n = n - 1 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}{{ x }}

name: deep recursion: a template that includes itself 60 deep and sets a variable in an asyncEach

templates.self.njk: {% set n = n - 1 %}{% asyncEach i in [1] %}{% set y = i %}{% if n > 0 %}{% include "self.njk" %}{% endif %}{% endeach %}{{ y }}

name: deep recursion: a template that imports itself with context 110 deep

templates.self.njk: {% if n > 0 %}{% set n = n - 1 %}{% import "self.njk" as m with context %}{% endif %}.

name: deep recursion: a macro that calls itself 120 deep
template: {% macro f(n) %}{% if n > 0 %}{{ f(n - 1) }}{% endif %}.{% endmacro %}{{ f(120) }}

name: deep recursion: a macro that calls itself 120 deep through a call block
template: {% macro f(n) %}{% if n > 0 %}{% call f(n - 1) %}{% endcall %}{% endif %}.{% endmacro %}{{ f(120) }}
